modern: Mind meets imagination. Strong imagination and intuitive, associative thinking. Fused, these drives are difficult to separate and ask to be consciously integrated rather than acted out blindly.

arcApplying: The two fuse and intensify as they close in.
arcSeparating: The fused theme peaks and discharges.

readerCopy.body: An idea or intuitive impression can feel convincing enough to shape a plan before its practical details have been checked. When Mercury conjoins Neptune, thought and imagination fuse, strengthening creativity, symbolism, and associative thinking while making facts easier to blur. Inspiration deserves to be captured before it disappears. Permanent decisions deserve enough logistics on paper to show what the idea can actually support.
